name: Dakshina dataset v1.0 (Google Research), Malayalam
licence_source: https://github.com/google-research-datasets/dakshina/blob/master/README.md#license ("The dataset is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0"). The repo has no LICENSE file.
attribution: Dakshina dataset by Google Research (Roark et al., 2020, LREC), CC BY-SA 4.0. Native-script text from Wikipedia; romanisations by Google's annotators.
verdict_reason: Share-alike, same position as Wikipedia (see the licence audit). Human romanisations are exactly what the rule probabilities need. Train split for training and for fitting the rule probabilities; dev and test splits held out for eval.
used_for: Only ml/lexicons/*.tsv (word, romanisation, count) and ml/romanized/*. The native_script_wikipedia text duplicates mlwiki and isn't used.
notes: The tar holds all 12 languages and is 2,008,340,480 bytes (Content-Length, 2026-11-03), over the 50 MB limit for this audit. Add a checksum when it is first fetched.
